{{Top}}
'''Zersium''' was an [[Ore/Legends|ore]] found on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], [[Koratas]], and [[Dor]]. It was used in the construction of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] and [[dura-armor]], specifically blaster rifles during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], and as zersium flecks in the black body glove worn by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], providing additional insulation and reducing thermal discomfort from impact with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt.
